terbaru.judul: Hierarchical emergence of network bursting in a four-cell central pattern generator model
terbaru.pelajaran: How can a neural circuit rhythmically burst when none of its constituent neurons can endogenously do so?

terbaru.judul: Dynamics-preserving network reductions for ride-pooling paths
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that such dynamics admit an exact coarse-grained representation: for a broad class of routing algorithms whose decisions depend only on path lengths, the full network can be reduced to an effective network of active nodes weighted by shortest-path distances without altering the resulting trajectories, up to stochastic degener

terbaru.judul: Reconstructing the information processing capacity of physical systems from noisy observations
terbaru.pelajaran: First, we show how to distinguish the dynamics of an unperturbed system from the noise-free component of the stochastic dynamics: The IPC measured for responses averaged over noise realizations is in general not the same as the IPC of the unperturbed system.

terbaru.judul: Learning Interaction Kernels from Collective Steady States
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a learning procedure for system identification in interacting particle systems from single-snapshot observations of collective behaviors, unlike existing approaches that rely on observations of trajectories.

terbaru.judul: Cortical information transfer reveals conserved hemispherical network dynamics across human handedness
terbaru.pelajaran: We demonstrate that cortical communication is strictly scale-dependent regardless of handedness: ipsilateral dominance occurs primarily in general, network-wide interactions, whereas inter-hemispheric interactions maintain a contralateral profile.

terbaru.judul: Making the Graph Laplacian Physical: Multiscale Coarse-Graining in Electrical Oscillator Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that, in resistor-coupled LC networks, the graph Laplacian defines an experimentally accessible hierarchy of electrical descriptions.

terbaru.judul: Breathing and moving vesicles in a geometric mechanochemical model
terbaru.pelajaran: We show how to compute bifurcation diagrams for such solution branches via numerical continuation and bifurcation methods.

terbaru.judul: Double explosive transitions in adaptive multilayer networks with higher-order interactions
terbaru.pelajaran: Can asymmetry between two interacting networks fundamentally change how they synchronize?

terbaru.judul: Exact Fragmentation and Terminal-Cluster Selection in One-Dimensional Finite-Range Normalized Alignment
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a one-dimensional normalized alignment model with a hard interaction cut-off and obtain exact predictions in an expansive regime.

terbaru.judul: Kuramoto Phase Synchronization in Regional Epidemic Dynamics: Two Test Cases from European COVID-19 and Influenza Surveillance
terbaru.pelajaran: We test whether the Kuramoto model quantitatively describes spatial synchronization in regional epidemic waves, using daily COVID-19 incidence for 400 German \emph{Kreise} (2021--2023) and weekly ILI rates for 12 European countries (ECDC, 2021--2026).
